description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Fish Potatoes, B'onions, Massor Dhal Etc., valid for a period of months commencing from 21.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders specifying tax rates on various commodities and rescinds previous orders.
